title: Developer Tools > API & Webhooks > Webhooks and API Integration Guide

sections.heading: BD API & Webhook Capabilities
sections.content:
Brilliant Directories provides a REST API and real-time outbound webhooks to sync data with external CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Make).
Supported Webhook events:
- Member Signup / Member Updated / Member Deleted
- New Form Submission (Contact Us, Lead Inquiries)
- Payment Received / Recurring Charge Failed

sections.heading: Setting Up Outbound Webhooks
sections.content:
1. Go to Developer Tools > Webhooks.
2. Click 'Add New Webhook'.
3. Select Trigger Event (e.g. 'member_signup').
4. Enter Target Webhook URL (e.g. Zapier or webhook receiver).
5. Test payload: BD sends a JSON POST request containing all user profile fields.
